title: Timeliness of Requests for Review — Decision Reviews and Appeals
content:
## Decision Reviews and Appeals — timeliness of requests for review

**(a) Higher-Level Review and Board appeals.** A Higher-Level Review or Board appeal is accepted only if it is received not later than 365 calendar days after the date of the notice of the decision under review. The filing period of 365 calendar days is the same in both Higher-Level Review lanes and on all three Board dockets.

**(b) Counting.** Count calendar days starting the day after the notice date; a request received on the last day is timely. The notice date is the notice date of the decision under review as it stands on VA's record of that decision, and the comparison is made on the date VA received the request. The request is timely when its receipt date is not later than the last day of the period; receipt on the last day itself satisfies the period.

**(c) Supplemental Claim.** A supplemental claim may be filed at any time, but only one filed within that window keeps the effective date.

**(d) Contested claims.** A contested claim must be filed within 60 calendar days.

**(e) Late requests.** A late request may be accepted only on a showing of good cause decided by the Board or the regional office, never on a service call.

**(f) Form and signature.** The request is made on the lane's required form and signed by the claimant.

### Counting table

| Day of receipt, counted from the day after the notice date | Higher-Level Review or Board appeal |
|---|---|
| Day 1 through day 364 | Timely |
| Day 365 (the last day) | Timely |
| Day 366 or later | Not timely; accepted only on a showing of good cause decided by the Board or the regional office |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Notice of the decision under review dated 10 June 2024. Day 1 is 11 June 2024, and day 365 is 10 June 2025. A Higher-Level Review received on 10 June 2025 is received on the last day and is timely.
- Same notice date. A Board appeal received on 11 June 2025 is received on day 366, after the period; it can be accepted only on a showing of good cause decided by the Board or the regional office, and that decision is not made on a service call.
- Same notice date. A supplemental claim received on 11 June 2025 may still be filed, because a supplemental claim may be filed at any time; having been filed outside the window, it does not keep the effective date.

### Points of judgement

- **Whose date governs?** The notice date is taken from VA's record of the decision under review, matched to that decision.
- **Is the notice date itself day 1?** No. The count starts the day after the notice date.
- **Can a representative on a service call accept a late request for good cause?** No. Good cause is decided by the Board or the regional office, never on a service call.
